brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks only geometry/mesh clearance, not material strength, load rating or print filament. Built 10 hex bases (5 lower: piece:0,0,0;full etc, 5 upper level 1) forming two-tier shelf frame - shape suggests shelves but load capacity cannot be verified or guaranteed in 3D-printed plastic; no rated component exists.

No drawer sockets offered on current build (find_sockets drawer 0). Notch drawer frames are available as parts but require specific empty notch geometry; attempted placement and removed. Build currently has no drawer frames installed.

finish.summary: Built 10-cell two-storey frame that can visually represent a shelf unit; added 5 upper bases on lower 5 bases. No caps/joint locks applied. Load rating 50 kg cannot be met by this 3D-printed modular system - configurator does not model materials or strength. Two drawers not installed as socket conditions were not satisfied.
